scripts.build-atlasmaker: webpack --mode production --config webpack.atlasmaker.config.js && cp view/atlasmaker/dist/atlasmaker.js view/atlasmaker/dist/atlasmaker.js.map public/lib/
scripts.build-atlasmaker-tools: webpack --mode production --config webpack.atlasmaker-tools.config.js && cp  -r view/atlasmaker/dist/atlasmaker-tools public/lib/
scripts.build-brainbox: webpack --mode production --config webpack.brainbox.config.js && cp view/brainbox/dist/brainbox.js view/brainbox/dist/brainbox.js.map public/lib/
scripts.build-pages: webpack --mode production --config webpack.pages.config.js && cp view/brainbox/dist/*-page.js view/brainbox/dist/*-page.js.map public/js/
scripts.build: npm run build-atlasmaker && npm run build-atlasmaker-tools && npm run build-brainbox && npm run build-pages
scripts.dev-atlasmaker: webpack --mode development --config webpack.atlasmaker.config.js && cp view/atlasmaker/dist/atlasmaker.js view/atlasmaker/dist/atlasmaker.js.map public/lib/
scripts.dev-atlasmaker-tools: webpack --mode development --config webpack.atlasmaker-tools.config.js && cp  -r view/atlasmaker/dist/atlasmaker-tools public/lib/
scripts.dev-brainbox: webpack --mode development --config webpack.brainbox.config.js && cp view/brainbox/dist/brainbox.js view/brainbox/dist/brainbox.js.map public/lib/
scripts.dev-pages: webpack --mode development --config webpack.pages.config.js && cp view/brainbox/dist/*-page.js view/brainbox/dist/*-page.js.map public/js/
scripts.dev: npm run dev-atlasmaker && npm run dev-atlasmaker-tools && npm run dev-brainbox && npm run dev-pages
scripts.test-unit: cross-env MONGODB='127.0.0.1:27017/brainbox_test' nyc --report-dir test/unit/coverage mocha --exit --timeout 5000 ./test/runner.js test/unit/*.js
scripts.test-integration: cross-env MONGODB='127.0.0.1:27017/brainbox_test' LOCALSIGNIN=true nyc --report-dir test/integration/coverage mocha --exit --timeout 5000 ./test/runner.js test/integration/*.js
scripts.mocha-test: cross-env MONGODB='127.0.0.1:27017/brainbox_test' LOCALSIGNIN=true nyc mocha --exit --timeout 5000 ./test/runner.js test/unit/*.js test/integration/*.js
